name: skynerd-genesis
description: Browser-native TypeScript + WebGPU port of the Skynerd Hebbian drone swarm

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.web.json && vite build && vite build --ssr server/standalone-entry.js --outDir dist/server --emptyOutDir false
